description.p: Lectern is a Markdown-native office suite for worldbuilding: documents, spreadsheets, diagrams, a drawing notebook and four structured worldbuilding databases, all writing plain text files into a folder you choose and control.
There is no project database and no proprietary container. The workspace is a directory of readable files you can back up with git, sync with anything, and open in any editor.

ul.li: Documents — Markdown with live preview, math and diagrams
Sheets — spreadsheets with 79 functions and charts
Diagrams — a Mermaid editor with a live canvas
Notebook and Maps — freehand ink, PDF annotation and world maps
Glossary, Calendar, Economy and Bestiary — structured data types
